status: Proposal only; shared limiter not modified. No policy or cap changed.
problem: slot reads central max once before its queue loop. Already queued jobs ignore later increases and decreases. J reproduced both against the exact current wrapper in isolated temporary directories.
scope: Move existing cap-file read into existing wait loop. Running jobs retain their acquired slots and are never killed. No new queue/lease/controller. Tests only read real wrapper; all test slots and cap files live in temporary directories.
deployment: For coordinator review. Installing it would affect future wrapper invocations; existing queued shells would need a safe queued-only replacement to load new script. No running native process should be restarted.
